metadata.title: IVF-SPEA2
metadata.description: Code, processed data, manuscript sources, and reproducibility artifacts for the IVF/SPEA2 study. This version accompanies the PPSN 2026 paper 'Operator-Host Compatibility in Multi-Objective Intensification: IVF Across SPEA2, NSGA-II, and NSGA-III' and contains the processed per-run endpoint metrics, dynamic trajectories, LaTeX tables, figure PDFs, and Python analysis scripts needed to reproduce every summary reported in that paper.
